title: Articulating
description: The constitutive generator from utterance into the aperiodic articulation regime. Articulating's domain is utterance; its codomain is the aperiodic-articulation-category whose initial presentation carries the potential-aperiodic-articulation-cell. The cell's life beyond that -- transitions to active, stable, or absurd -- is downstream morphism work internal to the generated category.

input.description: Articulating's domain: the utterance whose token/claim carrier opens the initial aperiodic articulation regime.

output.description: Articulating's codomain: the aperiodic-articulation-category generated from the utterance.
